name: R1 Interaction Grounding
ascii:
Legend: [D] = interaction state/surface, (O) = user operation.

                         R1 REPRESENTATION INTERACTION

 (O) Select a DiagramSet
       |    `DiagramSetTreePanel`
       v
 (O) Navigate grouped lineage
       |    `DiagramLineagePanel`
       |    candidate batches / variants / call graphs / directory views
       |    rank candidates / star preferred view
       +---- select component
       +---- choose layer by information rank ----> (O) layer / transition feedback
       |                                      `RepresentationLayersPanel`
       |
       v
 [D] Active immutable Representation artifact

+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [D] REPRESENTATION - orientation and manipulation surface                   |
|                                                                             |
|  [D] DiagramView                                                            |
|        |                                                                    |
|        v                                                                    |
|  [D] AsciiSelectionGrid + DiagramSelectionOverlay                           |
|        |                                                                    |
|        v                                                                    |
|  [D] stable RepresentationIndex - revision-scoped element identity          |
|      `representationIndex` / `representationPresentation` / `asciiTree`     |
|                                                                             |
|  (O) hover / click mapped element / rectangle selection                     |
|  (O) show mapped and highlighted state                                      |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
       | stable mapped element identity
       v
 (O) Dispatch mapped-element command
       `DomainProfile.ElementCommandId` / App handlers
       |
       +---- reveal Evidence
       +---- collapse subtree (presentation only)
       +---- toggle highlight (durable grounded context)
       +---- buffer reference ----> mapped Evidence temporary tray
       +---- selected Evidence ---> (O) focused Call Graph
       |                              `callGraphFocus`
       +---- rectangle selection -> [D] DiagramComponent capture
       |                              `diagramSelection`
       +---- edit mode -----------> markers / manual or LLM edits
                                      undo / redo
                                      publish immutable lineage child
                                      `EditOperationsPanel`

                         ONLY GROUNDING PATH

[Representation] --mapped reveal--> [Evidence] --authoritative ranges--> [Corpus]
       ^                         pane Back / Forward                         |
       +--------------------------------------------------------------------+
Evidence inspection: metadata + mapped ranges; Corpus passage verifies claim.
Grounding rule: Representation -> Evidence -> Corpus only.
No Representation -> Corpus source reveal; direct Corpus access is explicit browsing.

BOUNDARY: no evidence collection, agent generation, reference follow-up,
          mapping prompt execution, or persistence layout.
